Hymn 65: Come, All Ye Saints Who Dwell on Earth
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 65 titled "Come, All Ye Saints Who Dwell on Earth" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
